guardrails.rule: IF item_type == 'machinery_or_equipment' AND amount >= 5000.00 THEN cost_center MUST BE '0400_CAPEX'
guardrails.remediation: Change cost_center to '0400' and request asset number from plant engineering.
guardrails.expertRationale: Equipment over €5,000 is always Capex. Booking to 4711 ruins tax depreciation and triggers audit penalty.

guardrails.rule: IF cost_center == '0400_CAPEX' THEN asset_number CANNOT BE null OR empty
guardrails.remediation: Fetch registered asset tag from ERP Plant Maintenance table AST-*
guardrails.expertRationale: No asset number, no capex booking. Period.

guardrails.rule: IF vendor_name == 'Bauer Logistik GmbH' AND invoice_month == 12 THEN payment_status MUST BE 'FROZEN_HOLD'
guardrails.remediation: Do not release until Logistics Team Lead attaches signed paper delivery note.
guardrails.expertRationale: Bauer double-bills every December without fail due to billing software year-end glitches.

guardrails.rule: IF vendor_country != 'DE' AND is_subsidiary == true AND amount > 3000.00 THEN approval_tier MUST BE 'TIER_2_PLANT_DIRECTOR'
guardrails.remediation: Dispatch invoice to Brno subsidiary transfer pricing queue.
guardrails.expertRationale: Czech subsidiary invoices require dual signoff for tax compliance.
